All deliverables are complete in the working directory:

- **`orientation_selectivity_analysis.py`** / **`.ipynb`** — end-to-end jupytext script and executed notebook
- **`fig01`–`fig04`** — raw spike trains, example-neuron raster + polar tuning, PSTHs by direction, and a population summary (example curves by area, gOSI distribution, gOSI by area, sorted tuning matrix)
- **`unit_orientation_metrics.csv`**, **`tuning_curves_by_orientation.csv`** — per-unit metrics and tuning curves
- **`README.md`** — summary

Used DANDI:000021 (Allen Institute Visual Coding – Neuropixels), streaming one session directly from S3 via `remfile`. Of 622 well-isolated visual-cortex units, 455 (73%) were significantly orientation/direction-tuned (ANOVA p<0.01, median gOSI 0.21), with the population tuning matrix showing preferred orientations tiling the full 360° range — the classic orientation-selectivity signature.
